versions.subject: Detect modification of sysmon configuration by sysmon
versions.detection:
selection_stop:
    EventID: 4
    State: Stopped
selection_conf:
    EventID: 16
    message|startswith:
        - 'Sysmon config state changed'
selection_error:
    EventID: 255
    Description|contains:
        - 'Failed to open service configuration with error'
condition: 1 of them
versions.spl: (EventID=4 State="Stopped") OR (EventID=16 message="Sysmon config state changed*") OR (EventID=255 Description="*Failed to open service configuration with error*")

versions.subject: Get a new error after another Atomic Test

selection_error:

    Description|contains:
        - 'Failed to open service configuration with error'
        - 'Failed to connect to the driver to update configuration'
condition: 1 of them
versions.spl: (EventID=4 State="Stopped") OR (EventID=16 message="Sysmon config state changed*") OR (EventID=255 Description IN ("*Failed to open service configuration with error*", "*Failed to connect to the driver to update configuration*"))

        - 'Failed to open service configuration with error'
        - 'Failed to connect to the driver to update configuration'

    Description: 'Failed to open service configuration with error 19'
condition: selection_error
versions.spl: Description IN ("*Failed to open service configuration with error*", "*Failed to connect to the driver to update configuration*")

versions.subject: adding filter for false positive. no risk to sysmon operation
versions.detection:
selection_error:
    Description|contains:
        - 'Failed to open service configuration with error'
        - 'Failed to connect to the driver to update configuration'
selection_filter:
    Description: 'Failed to open service configuration with error 19 - Last error: The media is write protected.'
condition: selection_error and not selection_filter
versions.spl: Description IN ("*Failed to open service configuration with error*", "*Failed to connect to the driver to update configuration*") NOT Description="Failed to open service configuration with error 19 - Last error: The media is write protected."
